Still high influx from Ile-zik inward Ikeja and National as a result of broken down containerized Mack truck apprehended by Police officers but it has been towed out of the the road. 

It's cool ride after National down to Bolade intersection, only slight delays at traffic light points. 

The return journey is still in perfect shape.

data.raw_text:
sorry, this might be a bit long...

This is what we've been discussing among fandom friends too. In the setting of a third world country, much like the Philippines and Indonesia, not everyone is as privileged as us in being able to enjoy fandoms -- this includes NOT just the capacity to afford merch or buy concert/event tickets, BUT also having the right resources and environment that fosters hobbies...

Whereas in one country, a fan can easily set aside allowance for splurging in hobbies... we have situations like ours that demand the whole salary for living expenses, some even barely covering it.

Where one can easily visit a concert/event location because they have access to good transportation, we have ours that costs so much more just to traverse islands.

When your transport to and from work demands that you wake up at 3 or 4AM for a 9AM shift just because you have to brave gruelling traffic, with the same story as going back home... where will you find time and energy to engage in fandom activities? watch idols? sleep? eat?

My iska blood is peaking but I always stand by the philosophy that everything is and will always be political. So I hope for 2028, even your fangirl/boy self considers these and vote right. 🥲

On another note but on the same branch of topic, it infuriates me when Knetz questions International fans' streaming participation as proof of being "true PLLI/fan." The hurdle of having to overcome the language barrier, the import and international shipping fees, the difference in streaming timezones, and even event accessibility and voting restrictions - these are only some of our challenges and yet we are still here, avidly supporting our idols and oshis... 🥹

// end of long rant. my hormones are crazy rn hahahahuhuhu anyhoo please send support for our ASEAN brothers and sisters. our whole region is crazy chaotic rn 🫠
